title: Two Start Sidebars
description: A three-pane mail layout with two start ShellSidebar columns, a toggleable folders nav and a wider message list that appears only at 4xl shell widths, where choosing a folder filters the list and choosing a message fills the ShellMain reading pane. Use it for list-detail apps like mail or inboxes that need two columns before the content, and for reusing Nav rows with landmark={false} outside navigation landmarks.
